events.title: GraphCMS rebranded as Hygraph
events.summary: GraphCMS rebranded to Hygraph on July 12, 2022 — launching a federated content platform that unifies content from multiple APIs via GraphQL.
events.about: Hygraph expanded beyond pure [CMS] into content federation — stitching siloed backends into one GraphQL [API]. The rebrand reflected ambitions beyond headless [CMS] toward composable enterprise content infrastructure.

narrative.whyChosen: Hygraph pushed headless [CMS] toward federated, composable content layers.
narrative.whyImportant: Content federation addressed enterprise data silos without custom [middleware].
narrative.problemSolved: Enterprises stored content across dozens of systems with no unified query layer.

events.title: EU Digital Services Act adopted
events.summary: The European Parliament and Council adopted the Digital Services Act on July 5, 2022 — imposing transparency, illegal-content removal, and algorithmic accountability rules on online platforms and search engines.
events.about: The DSA complements [GDPR] and the DMA: very large online platforms must publish risk assessments, offer recommender-system choices, and share data with researchers. Trust-and-safety teams, content moderators, and ML engineers building feeds faced new documentation and audit requirements — a template other democracies studied for their own platform laws.

narrative.whyChosen: The DSA is Europe's comprehensive content-moderation and platform-transparency law.
narrative.whyImportant: It mandated algorithm transparency and researcher data access for the largest platforms.
narrative.problemSolved: EU lawmakers wanted enforceable rules for illegal content and opaque recommendation algorithms.
